notes.title: 2024.06.26 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed two autosave issues
Added Korean localization

notes.title: 2024.05.04 Optimization update
notes.notes:
-Modify the auto-save function. Now it will only auto-save at important times. Even if you forget to save, you don’t have to play again.
-Added more game tips and guidance so that everyone can advance the game without stress.

notes.title: 2024.04.08 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed mask character portrait performance
Fixed the issue of different hair colors of the male protagonist

notes.title: 2024.04.06 Update
notes.notes:
- Comprehensively optimize animation resources to solve low detection rate and possible lag problems.
- Removed the drugged bread puzzle that may cause bugs.

We hope to solve the unexpected problems that everyone encountered in the game very much, and thank you again for your support and patience.
